title: finding: ADR-0087 artifact forward conversion never walks a `packages[]` body, so an option-B artifact built before a retirement is refused at boot ("`packages[0]` is not a package entry … `dashboard.refreshInterval` was renamed")
body:
Filing gate **①**: a product defect, measured at a public door, with a named landing point. **Class (a):** a declared upgrade path (ADR-0087 D2 replay) that one artifact shape never gets. `reach:` the artifact boot door (`os dev -a dist/objectstack.json --fresh`), measured.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `os-steve` · session `session_01VoSxBQujKLZKPwK2u5ehQ6`. It comes from #22994's dev (`os-dev-report` `6122651929`, out-of-scope finding 1; PR #23024 at `86d2782f09`). ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** triage grades it. Its likely landing point is the conversion layer (`packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion.ts`, beside #23001's window), so it likely reads as `domain:engine`.

## What is measured

An **option-B** artifact (ADR-0130 D4: the stack's items sit in `packages[0].manifest`, not in the definition's own collections) carries a dashboard with the retired `refreshInterval: 300`. Booted with `os dev -a dist/objectstack.json --fresh`, it exits at boot (health `000`):

> ✗ Release artifact `packages[0]` is not a package entry (ADR-0130 D4): manifest.dashboards.0.refreshInterval: `dashboard.refreshInterval` was renamed to `refreshIntervalSeconds`…

The same refusal comes in-process from `MetadataPlugin._parseAndRegisterArtifact` (`invalid_type` at `packages.0.manifest.dashboards.0.refreshInterval`).

The CONTROL is the same dashboard in the definition's own `dashboards` collection: it is converted on that door, and #22994's PR measures it served as `refreshIntervalSeconds: 300`, valid.

## Why (the dev's reading, not re-measured by the seat)

The ADR-0087 artifact conversion walks the definition's own collections and never a `packages[].manifest` body. So every retired key inside a package body reaches the strict parse unconverted. An option-B artifact built before any retirement cannot boot after it.

## Not measured

- Retired keys other than `dashboard.refreshInterval` inside a package body (the code path is shared, so every major-18 entry is a suspect).
- A multi-package `packages[]`.
- Whether a config boot (`composeStacks`) of the same shape meets the same refusal.

## Relation to open cards

- **#23001** is the conversion WINDOW for a `^18` floor. This card is a different position in the same layer: the conversion's REACH into package bodies.
- **#22994** is `AppPlugin`'s registration seam. It cannot fix this, because the refusal happens at the metadata door's parse, before `AppPlugin` runs.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included:
- `artifact forward conversion packages manifest body retired key option-B package entry ADR-0130 refused at boot`: 17 hits. The nearest are #22994, #23001 and #12772 (no artifact door ran the conversion at all; closed). None is this subject.
- CONTROL: `ADR-0087 forward conversion artifact` returns #22994, #23001 and #12772, this family's own cards, so the instrument reaches it.

Dedupe words: option-B packages body forward conversion not applied; packages[].manifest retired key artifact refused; ADR-0130 D4 package entry ADR-0087 conversion.
